title: Natural Earth antialiased display land mask
purpose: High-resolution display coastline for the globe renderer, not a change to the scientific data resolution or support mask.

georeferencing.orientation: North at top; west-to-east columns; north-to-south rows; same registration as earth-terrain.webp.
georeferencing.pixelSampling: Pixel centers; latitude = 90 - (y + 0.5) * 180 / height; longitude = -180 + (x + 0.5) * 360 / width.

encoding.intermediate: Antialiased display coverage at geographic boundaries; not a scientific confidence or fraction variable.

processing.resampling: Lanczos downsampling with periodic horizontal padding
processing.polygons: Union of source polygons, with holes removed within each polygon; source date-line and polar geometry retained.

displayNotes: Use as a rendering coastline only; do not use this mask to redefine or remove CarbonGlobe source cells.
Original ED data exports and the Original dots view retain all source cells, including coastal cells outside this cartographic outline.
Higher raster dimensions improve display edges; the scientific dataset remains on its original 0.5-degree grid.
Only holes present in the pinned land polygons are removed; this is not a comprehensive separate inland-water dataset.
